title: 5 websites that
feel *illegal*
to know
slides.sub: No sign-up tricks. No paid trial. Just open them.

slides.name: Photo*pea*
slides.line: A Photoshop-style editor that runs free in your browser.

rows.v: Open photopea.com, then File, then Open

slides.name: Tiny*Wow*
slides.line: Free tools to merge, compress and convert PDFs, images and videos.

rows.v: Pick a tool, drop your file in

slides.name: remove*.bg*
slides.line: Cuts the background out of any photo in about 5 seconds.

rows.v: Upload a photo, download the cut-out

slides.name: Perplex*ity*
slides.line: Answers your question and shows the sources it used.

rows.v: Ask a question, tap the numbered sources

slides.catch: Still open the sources before you trust it.

slides.name: Notebook*LM*
slides.line: Upload your notes or PDFs. It makes a study guide, a quiz and a podcast of them.

rows.v: New notebook, add your PDF or notes

slides.title: Send this to *a friend.*
slides.who: The one who still pays for every app.
slides.text: and I'll DM you all 5 links + how to use each
